meta.name: Gone With The Bullets
meta.description: Set in 1920s Shanghai, Ma Zouri and Xiang Feitian establish a notorious beauty pageant called the Flowers Competition. All of the city's elite attend the gala event, but when Wanyan Ying unexpectedly wins, it sets into motion a series of tragic events that change their destinies.
meta.slogan: They called it a scandal. He called it a life. One step between the two.
